== Description ==
'''SHA-200''' is the one of the many Shadow entities found within the [[Shadow Challenge]] and the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] modifier. He is the infected counterpart of [[A-200]].

== Behavior ==
'''SHA-200''' spawns at the very back, playing a sound akin to wind slightly blowing. He is one of the "forced entities" in [[Shadow Challenge]]. He will aim-script to the player, no matter where you are. If he reaches you and you're not inside of a locker, you die. If he reaches you and you're in a locker, you get breached. '''SHA-200'''<nowiki/>'s breach is similar to the breach used by [[Striketeam Solstice]], however the screen becomes dark, only revealing the area around your cursor.

== Strategy & Tips ==
<tabber>
|-|Unhidden=
'''Unhidden:'''
* If you hear or are sure that the '''SHA-200''' has appeared, you should immediately hide, as [[Claustrophobia]] does not appear during its attack
* Don't try to hide in a safe place, because the '''SHA-200''' can easily find you there, because it always knows where you are.
* You have the opportunity to escape from the '''SHA-200''', as its speed is equal to the speed of [[Mouth|A-300]], so he's faster than you, but if you run as fast as you can, you'll be faster
** But note that if there are <u>multiple players</u> in the game, then it will be impossible to escape from the '''SHA-200'''
|-|Hidden=
'''Hidden:'''
* Wait for '''SHA-200'''
*  Wait for the mini-game to start, as with [[Striketeam Solstice]]
** Keep the cursor in the center of the circle
** If you've lost the circle (and it's moving), wiggle the cursor back and forth to find it, or take a closer look
</tabber>

== Trivia ==
* SHA-200 is forced to spawn after having gone completed around 80-90% Of the [[Shadow Challenge]] (if you haven't encountered it yet), and room 666 in [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse|A&SP]] after the words:
** <span style="text-shadow: 0 0 5px black; color: #5509D2;">You've gone too far for your own good.</span>
** <span style="text-shadow: 0 0 5px black; color: #390789;">Now put on a great show for us.</span>
** <span style="text-shadow: 0 0 5px black; color: #5E0A0B;">..You heard something in the distance.</span>
* SHA-200's Breach Soundtrack is called "Good luck" by Musicmanaz on YouTube.
** https://youtu.be/ycYFr34dvX4?si=Ov1gEmJDwXzpQmat
* Surviving SHA-200 3 times during [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] will award you "[https://www.roblox.com/badges/3894791347386141/The-Apocalypse The Apocolypse]" badge
